provenance.notes: Presentation of WebServices V1.2 (February 2026): no batch calls, requests spread over the day as end users need them; a shipment tracked 4 to 6 times a day at most and no more once delivered or returned (per parcel: no scope of the schema counts it, so not declared); one call per point search, never the whole network, 30 points at most, radius up to 75 km (100 km for 24R/24L). The SOAP shipment creation (WSI2_CreationEtiquette, which this package calls) is "no longer maintained and should not be used": labels go through API2 (REST); API2 labels must not be altered or resized. Access with the merchant's enseigne and private key. No idempotency key: a label is created once.
